name: Australian Grand Prix
sources_2026_10_03: formula1.com race report and official race result, FIA final classification, BBC Sport, Motorsport.com; all 2026-03-08. Verified 2026-10-03 against the FIA final classification, final starting grid and qualifying classification: Piastri and Hulkenberg DNF->DNS; grid corrected for Hulkenberg, Ocon, Albon, Alonso, Sainz; qualifying positions and missing Q1/Q2/Q3 times filled. summary: George Russell won by 2.974s from Mercedes team mate Kimi Antonelli after an early fight with Ferrari's Charles Leclerc. Two VSC periods, triggered by Isack Hadjar and Valtteri Bottas, shaped the strategy: Mercedes stopped under the first while Ferrari stayed out, then ran a one-stop plan to the flag. Max Verstappen recovered from P20 to sixth, while Oscar Piastri crashed on the way to the grid and Arvid Lindblad scored on debut. Six cars were not classified, including both Aston Martins, Bottas and Hadjar, while Piastri and Nico Hulkenberg did not start; no post-race penalty changed the order.
